symptoms.symptom: Surface units will not maintain a rolling boil or cooking is not fast enough

causes.label: Improper cookware being used.
remedies: Use pans which are flat and match the diameter of the surface unit selected.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Improper cookware being used."

symptoms.symptom: Surface units do not work properly

causes.label: A fuse in your home may be blown or the circuit breaker tripped.
remedies: Replace the fuse or reset the circuit breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "A fuse in your home may be blown or the circuit breaker tripped."

causes.label: Cooktop controls improperly set.
remedies: Check to see the correct control is set for the surface unit you are using.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Cooktop controls improperly set."

symptoms.symptom: Tiny scratches (may appear as cracks) or abrasions on radiant cooktop glass surface

causes.label: Incorrect cleaning methods being used.
remedies: Use recommended cleaning procedures.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Incorrect cleaning methods being used."

causes.label: Cookware with rough bottoms being used or coarse particles (salt or sand) were between the cookware and the surface of the cooktop.
remedies: Be sure cookware bottoms and cookware are clean before use.
Use cookware with smooth bottoms.
Tiny scratches are not removable but will become less visible in time as a result of cleaning.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Cookware with rough bottoms being used or coarse particles (salt or sand) were between the cookware and the surface of the cooktop."

causes.label: Cookware has been slid across the cooktop surface.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Cookware has been slid across the cooktop surface."

symptoms.symptom: Areas of discoloration on the cooktop

causes.label: Improper cookware being used.
remedies: Marks from aluminum and copper pans as well as mineral deposits from water or food can be removed with the cleaning cream.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Improper cookware being used."

causes.label: Hot surface on a model with a white glass cooktop.
remedies: This is normal.
The surface may appear discolored when it is hot.
This is temporary and will disappear as the glass cools.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Hot surface on a model with a white glass cooktop."

symptoms.symptom: Pitting of the cooktop

causes.label: Hot sugar mixture spilled on the cooktop.
remedies: Call a qualified technician for replacement.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Hot sugar mixture spilled on the cooktop."

symptoms.symptom: Frequent cycling off and on of surface units

causes.label: Improper cookware being used.
remedies: Use only flat cookware to minimize cycling.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 33: "Improper cookware being used."

symptoms.symptom: Food does not bake or roast properly

causes.label: Oven controls improperly set.
remedies: See the Using the oven section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Oven controls improperly set."

causes.label: Shelf position is incorrect or the shelf is not level.
remedies: See the Using the oven section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Shelf position is incorrect or the shelf is not level."

causes.label: Incorrect cookware or cookware of improper size being used.
remedies: See the Using the oven section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Incorrect cookware or cookware of improper size being used."

causes.label: Oven thermostat needs adjustment.
remedies: See the Adjust the oven thermostat—Do it yourself! section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Oven thermostat needs adjustment."

symptoms.symptom: Food does not broil properly

causes.label: Oven controls improperly set.
remedies: Make sure you touch the BROIL HI/LO pad.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Oven controls improperly set."

symptoms.symptom: Oven temperature too hot or too cold

causes.label: Oven thermostat needs adjustment.
remedies: See the Adjust the oven thermostat—Do it yourself! section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Oven thermostat needs adjustment."

symptoms.symptom: Oven door is crooked

causes.label: The door is out of position.
remedies: Because the oven door is removable, it sometimes gets out of position during installation.
To straighten the door, push down on the high corner.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "The door is out of position."

symptoms.symptom: Storage drawer is crooked

causes.label: Rear drawer support is on top of the guide rail.
remedies: Reposition the drawer.
See the Storage Drawer Removal instructions in the Care and cleaning of your range section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Rear drawer support is on top of the guide rail."

symptoms.symptom: Storage drawer won’t close

causes.label: Power cord may be obstructing drawer in the lower back of the range.
remedies: Reposition the drawer and power cord.
See the Storage Drawer Removal instructions in the Care and cleaning of your range section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Power cord may be obstructing drawer in the lower back of the range."

causes.label: Rear drawer support is on top of the guide rail.
remedies: Reposition the drawer.
See the Storage Drawer Removal instructions in the Care and cleaning of your range section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 34: "Rear drawer support is on top of the guide rail."

symptoms.symptom: Oven will not self-clean

causes.label: The oven temperature is too high to set a self-clean operation.
remedies: Allow the range to cool to room temperature and reset the controls.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "The oven temperature is too high to set a self-clean operation."

causes.label: Oven controls improperly set.
remedies: See the Using the self-cleaning oven section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "Oven controls improperly set."

causes.label: The probe is plugged into the outlet in the oven. (on some models)
remedies: Remove the probe from the oven.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "The probe is plugged into the outlet in the oven. (on some models)"

symptoms.symptom: “Crackling” or “popping” sound

causes.label: This is the sound of the metal heating and cooling during both the cooking and cleaning functions.
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "This is the sound of the metal heating and cooling during both the cooking and cleaning functions."

symptoms.symptom: Excessive smoking during a clean cycle

causes.label: Excessive soil.
remedies: Touch the CLEAR/OFF pad.
Open the windows to rid the room of smoke.
Wait until the LOCKED DOOR light goes off.
Wipe up the excess soil and reset the clean cycle.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "Excessive soil."

symptoms.symptom: Oven door will not open after a clean cycle

causes.label: Oven too hot.
remedies: Allow the oven to cool below locking temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "Oven too hot."

symptoms.symptom: LOCKED DOOR light is on when you want to cook

causes.label: The oven door is locked because the temperature inside the oven has not dropped below the locking temperature.
remedies: Touch the CLEAR/OFF pad.
Allow the oven to cool.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 35: "The oven door is locked because the temperature inside the oven has not dropped below the locking temperature."

symptoms.symptom: Control signals after entering cooking time or start time

causes.label: You forgot to enter a bake temperature or cleaning time.
remedies: Touch the BAKE pad and desired temperature or the SELF CLEAN pad and desired clean time.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "You forgot to enter a bake temperature or cleaning time."

symptoms.symptom: Display goes blank

causes.label: A fuse in your home may be blown or the circuit breaker tripped.
remedies: Replace the fuse or reset the circuit breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "A fuse in your home may be blown or the circuit breaker tripped."

causes.label: The clock is in the black-out mode.
remedies: See the Special features of your oven control section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "The clock is in the black-out mode."

symptoms.symptom: Display flashes

causes.label: Power failure.
remedies: Reset the clock.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "Power failure."

symptoms.symptom: Unable to get the display to show “SF”

causes.label: Oven control pads were not touched properly.
remedies: The BAKE and BROIL HI/LO pads must be touched at the same time and held for 3 seconds.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "Oven control pads were not touched properly."

symptoms.symptom: “Probe” appears in the display (on some models)

causes.label: This is reminding you to enter a probe temperature after plugging in the probe.
remedies: Enter a probe temperature.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "This is reminding you to enter a probe temperature after plugging in the probe."

symptoms.symptom: Power outage, clock flashes

causes.label: Power outage or surge.
remedies: Reset the clock.
If the oven was in use, you must reset it by touching the CLEAR/OFF pad, setting the clock and resetting any cooking function.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "Power outage or surge."

symptoms.symptom: Steam from the vent

causes.label: When using the convection feature, it is normal to see steam coming out of the oven vent. As the number of shelves or amount of food being cooked increases, the amount of visible steam will increase.
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "When using the convection feature, it is normal to see steam coming out of the oven vent. As the number of shelves or amount of food being cooked increases, the amount of visible steam will increase."

symptoms.symptom: “Burning” or “oily” odor emitting from the vent

causes.label: This is normal in a new oven and will disappear in time.
remedies: To speed the process, set a self-clean cycle for a minimum of 3 hours.
See the Using the selfcleaning oven section.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "This is normal in a new oven and will disappear in time."

symptoms.symptom: Surface light does not work

causes.label: Switch operating light is broken.
remedies: Call for service.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 36: "Switch operating light is broken."
